data.name: Elementra: The Sundered World
data.detailed_description:
Elementra: The Sundered World

"Between the Light and Dark - what will you choose...?"

"Being kind is beautiful. Being only kind is deadly."

The darkness is not evil. The darkness is your ally.

Forget everything you thought you knew about heroes. In a world where the Light blinds and naivety kills, only those who embrace Balance survive.

You are an anomaly in the system.

Kindness without a blade is a sacrifice. Mercy without thorns is weakness.
Elementra: The Sundered World is a cross-platform RPG 2D/3D-person control, that won't hold your hand. It will ask you: "What are you willing to sacrifice to remain yourself?"

Here, you don't need someone else's ideals. You need your own power.
🔹 Embrace your Wrath. Make it your shield, against which the armies of Noctus will shatter.
🔹 Stop trying to save everyone. Learn to save yourself, so you can lead others.
🔹 Allow yourself to be imperfect. It is only through the cracks in your armor that true strength emerges.

Welcome to the Ancient World, torn apart by a war of the elements.

World:

In the beginning, there was only the Essence - the nexus of universal energy.

Then it split into two parts - Light and Darkness.

Afterward, Light separated from itself - Air and Water, while Darkness gave birth to Fire and Earth.

The Pact of the Elements was: all living things are created jointly, so that every being contains particles of all the elements.
However, every living creature, always has a trace of the universal Essence - a tiny Void.
The particle of energy that, during the formation, lands in this spot, determines the element.

Statistically, the void of a stone giant is more likely to be filled by a particle of Earth, but chance can vary. Therefore, one can encounter paradoxes, such as a bat under the sign of the Light element or a faun under the sign of Fire.

A creature can call its element and draw power from it: to use elemental abilities, both in battle and in everyday life.

When the younger elements had developed and grown strong, all six great and equal Powers began to shape the world.

Mages are Anomalies, "flawed templates" in creation

Born with an unsealed Void (no elemental particle fills it)

The Void pocket can stores immense, global amounts of energy

So, you are an anomaly in the system.

You wield power, that can save the world or burn it to ashes.

What will you do?

The player doesn't take role of a superhero, he is an agent of change in a living, breathing world where magic has a real price and consequence. The themes that will hook people:

  • Authentic Agency: Choices not illusion. Decide, what you answer to NPC - it will 100% change scenario

  • Intellectual & Tactical Satisfaction: DEEP tactical combat combines with the meta-game of managing your collection

  • Belonging to an Epic Saga: You are not an observer, but a central figure in a conflict of ideologies with no clear-cut "good" or "evil"

  • Freedom from Tropes: Shattering the "chosen one" cliché. The plot is created from within by the player himself

So, player are an error in the system.

But have some sort of "the key".

He is not the "Chosen One"

He is a mage in the system, that tried to control all His power is limited by the Council...

...but they don't know, that he awakened the Elementrum

Ancient artifact, pocket world, source of power that connected to heart of this world.

Player's freedom is a threat to all.

  • ﻿The Council wants to control him

  • ﻿The Church wants to "purify" him

  • ﻿The Cult wants to destroy him

COMMAND THE DARKNESS TO PROTECT THE LIGHT

Your journey isn't a story of a fall; it's a story of an ascent.
Noctus seeks to plunge reality into a silent void. Stopping him with only righteous prayers? Suicide.
Master six opposing elements, binding ice with flame, mingling light with shadow in your very veins. Forge an army from nightmares who will worship the ground you walk on.

WHAT MAKES ELEMENTRA AN ICON IN THE GENRE? (Spoiler: It's not a clone)

We are an indie studio tired of compromises. We built the game we want to play. Forget "flagship features" that only exist in ads. Here is your reality:

⚔ TRUE PvP. NO MERCY.
No "side" modes. Only blood and tactics. Here, you'll learn the true cost of your army when the honor of a Dark Lord is on the line. Prove that your Balance is the most perfect.

🤝 TRUE CO-OP. OR YOU WON'T SURVIVE.
Unite with those you trust with your back. Raid bosses in Elementra aren't HP sponges. They are puzzles of steel and magic, demanding perfect coordination. If you lead your friends into battle, let your plan be flawless.

📈 DEEP PROGRESSION. UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION.
Forget linear leveling. Grow your Lord like a living weapon. Create units that become an extension of your will. Want to build an army that overwhelms with numbers? Or an elite shadow squad that decides the battle's fate with a single strike? The choice is yours.

🎨 STUNNING GRAPHICS.
We've pushed platforms to their limits to deliver a new-generation world right into your hands (or on your monitor). Dark fantasy breathes here. Shadows live their own lives, and every corner of the Ancient World holds a secret you'll want (or fear) to uncover.

This is our first game. Our debut, uncompromising attempt to give you an unforgettable experience. We didn't set out to copy success — we set out to forge a legend.

Your army is tired of waiting. It is hungry. It craves your command.

Elementra: The Sundered World is available now.
Download. Enter the Darkness. Find your Balance.

P.S. If you're planning on saving everyone — don't even start. This world will devour you. But if you're ready to accept your Shadow — welcome home, Lord.

data.short_description: Real co-op battles, PvP, and an epic saga. Darkness is your ally. True power is born in the balance between the Light of kindness and the Darkness of your boundaries. Be imperfect to stay alive.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1, Windows 11 21H2
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 / Vulkan-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 or newer (X64), Windows 11 21H2 or newer (Arm64)
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or newer / Vulkan-capable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1, M2) or Intel x64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M3, M4) or Intel x64
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
